summary: Russian Tu-95MS bombers have been redeployed to Engels and Olenya airfields in preparation for a potential mass missile strike, with at least five bombers staged in the Far East and another expected to join. Meanwhile, US special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Kyiv for negotiations with Ukrainian President Zelensky and other officials, with European representatives expected to join subsequent rounds. Russian forces continue widespread drone and missile attacks across multiple Ukrainian regions while conducting ground advances in the Donbas.
key_points: Russian Tu-95MS bombers redeployed from the Far East to Engels and Olenya airfields, armed with cruise missiles, in preparation for a potential mass missile strike expected late next week (Source: @eRadarrua/111094).

US special envoys Witkoff and Kushner arrived in Kyiv by train for negotiations with Zelensky and Ukrainian officials, with European representatives expected to join subsequent rounds (Source: @UkraineNow/83925, @UkraineNow/83923).

Russian forces launched reactive UAVs and loitering munitions across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kharkiv, Zaporizhzhia, Dnipropetrovsk, Odessa, and Mykolaiv, with specific targets including Lozova, Vilniansk, Antonivka, and Balakliia (Source: @kpszsu/76927, @eRadarrua/111108, @kpszsu/76905).

Ukraine conducted a strike on the Ryazan oil refinery, one of Russia's largest with a capacity of approximately 17 million tons of oil per year, which supplies fuel to Russian occupation forces (Source: @eRadarrua/111093).

Ukrainian President Zelensky stated that the Donbas issue is central to the war and expects the US to increase Patriot missile production, while Ukrainian defense officials warn of insufficient Patriot missiles for winter defense (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33054, @ukr_leaks_eng/33046).

Russian forces advanced near Kostyantynivka in the Donbas, and Russian paratroopers assaulted a Ukrainian fortified position in the Orekhovsky direction (Source: @DeepStateUA/23807, @tass_agency/394122).
Russian defense ministry claimed a strike on a production and loading complex in Izmail port used for unloading military cargo from ships (Source: @tass_agency/394128).

Threats of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Voronezh and Kursk regions were reported, alongside the downing of 33 UAVs over Voronezh region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73803, @mon1tor_ua/73802, @tass_agency/394124).

sections.executive_summary: Russian military is preparing for a potential mass missile strike with Tu-95 bombers repositioning to Engels and Olenya airfields, while US special envoys Witkoff and Kushner arrive in Kyiv for negotiations with Ukrainian officials. Russian forces continue drone and missile attacks across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kherson, Zaporizhzhia, and Odessa. Ukrainian forces conducted a strike on the Ryazan oil refinery, and Russian ground advances were reported near Kostyantynivka.
ukraine: Ukrainian President Zelensky gifted 'Kiev Regime' t-shirts to US special envoys Witkoff and Kushner during their Kyiv visit, while also stating that the Donbas issue is central to the war and expecting increased US Patriot missile production. Ukrainian defense adviser Sergey Beskrestnov warned that Ukraine is unlikely to obtain sufficient Patriot missiles to protect against attacks this winter, according to The Guardian (Source: @UkraineNow/83928, @ukr_leaks_eng/33054, @ukr_leaks_eng/33046).

An anti-corruption operation named 'Carthage' resulted in the detention of Serhiy Kropiva, deputy head of the International Cooperation Department of the Prosecutor General's Office, with bail set at 120 million hryvnias, and Elizabeth Ivakhnenko, referred to as 'Muse' in NABU recordings, also facing detention measures (Source: @UkraineNow/83931, @UkraineNow/83919).

Ukrainian Prosecutor General Ruslan Kravchenko has been missing since Friday amid an anti-corruption investigation into the protection of fraudulent call centers in his office, while a search of a prosecutor's office employee's home revealed a safe (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33047, @ukr_leaks_eng/33042).
The Orlovka checkpoint on the border with Romania in the Odessa region has suspended operations due to attacks on border infrastructure (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33043).

A warehouse of a logistics company in Dnepropetrovsk caught fire after a series of explosions, and a shopping mall in Zaporizhzhia caught fire following a drone attack by Russian forces (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33051, @UkraineNow/83935).
russia: Russian Tu-95MS bombers were redeployed from the Far East to Engels airfield, armed with cruise missiles, with another expected to redeploy to Olenya airfield, marking the second such deployment this week in preparation for a potential mass missile strike (Source: @eRadarrua/111094).

The Kremlin indicated it has no intention of abandoning its military goals in Ukraine, with Putin willing to end the war only on Russian terms, and demands becoming stricter as Moscow believes it has a military advantage over Ukraine (Source: @eRadarrua/111095, @UkraineNow/83918).

Russian defense officials claimed a strike on a production and loading complex in Izmail port used for unloading military cargo from ships, and Russian paratroopers assaulted a Ukrainian fortified position in the Orekhovsky direction (Source: @tass_agency/394128, @tass_agency/394122).

Russian forces developed equipment to convert any UAV into a 'Doomsday' drone designed to address consequences of nuclear strikes, according to the general designer of the Central Design Bureau of Radio Engineering (Source: @tass_agency/394125).

A girl died from injuries sustained in a drone attack in Sevastopol, according to the regional governor, and 33 UAVs were downed over Voronezh region in one night (Source: @tass_agency/394092, @tass_agency/394124).
eastern_front: Russian forces advanced near Kostyantynivka in the Donbas, as reported by DeepState map updates, and Russian paratroopers assaulted a Ukrainian fortified position in the Orekhovsky direction (Source: @DeepStateUA/23807, @tass_agency/394122).

Russian forces launched reactive UAVs and loitering munitions towards multiple locations in the Donbas and surrounding regions, including Shakhtarske in Dnipropetrovsk region from the southeast and positions near Krasnoarmiysk (Source: @kpszsu/76942, @tass_agency/394113).

The Kremlin reaffirmed its commitment to achieving all military objectives in Ukraine, with Russian officials stating that the war will only end on Russian terms and that the military situation favors Russian forces (Source: @eRadarrua/111095, @UkraineNow/83918).

Ukrainian President Zelensky emphasized that the Donbas issue is central to the conflict, stating that it is not just a Donbas issue but the issue of the war itself, while expecting increased US Patriot missile production (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33054).
northern_front: Russian forces launched reactive UAVs towards Lozova in Kharkiv region from Donetsk, and 'Banderson' loitering munitions were detected on course for Balakliia in Kharkiv region (Source: @eRadarrua/111118, @kpszsu/76901, @kpszsu/76959).

A reactive UAV was also detected over Merefa in Kharkiv region from the south, and multiple drone sightings were reported across Kharkiv, Sumy, and Chernihiv regions (Source: @kpszsu/76951, @eRadarrua/111108).

Threats of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches were reported from Voronezh and Kursk regions, with air defense and radar alerts issued for these areas (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73803, @mon1tor_ua/73802).
Russian forces claimed to have struck Ukrainian positions in Krasnoarmiysk using drones, though details of the attack remain limited (Source: @tass_agency/394113).
southern_front: Russian forces launched reactive UAVs towards Antonivka in Kherson region, and multiple UAVs were detected over southern Odessa from the Black Sea, including towards Izmail, Bessarabske, and Tatarbunary (Source: @kpszsu/76927, @kpszsu/76932, @kpszsu/76936, @kpszsu/76937, @kpszsu/76940).

Russian reactive UAVs were also detected over Novomykolaivka in Odessa from the Black Sea, and towards Sarata in Odessa from the southeast, while the Orlovka border checkpoint with Romania suspended operations due to attacks on border infrastructure (Source: @kpszsu/76935, @kpszsu/76933, @ukr_leaks_eng/33043).

Russian forces claimed to have struck a production and loading complex in Izmail port used for unloading military cargo from ships, and a girl died from injuries from a drone attack in Sevastopol (Source: @tass_agency/394128, @tass_agency/394092).
Reactive UAVs were detected in Mykolaiv region, including over Voznesensk district and towards Berezhivka, with one originating from Crimea (Source: @kpszsu/76930, @eRadarrua/111102, @kpszsu/76949).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian military preparations, including the redeployment of Tu-95MS bombers to Engels and Olenya airfields with cruise missiles, indicate a potential mass missile strike expected late next week. The Kremlin's stated position that it will only end the war on Russian terms, combined with continued ground advances in the Donbas, suggests the conflict is likely to intensify. Ukrainian officials warn of insufficient Patriot missiles for winter defense, while Russian forces continue widespread drone and missile attacks across multiple regions, creating a volatile security environment.
sections.regional_response: US special envoys Witkoff and Kushner conducted negotiations in Kyiv, with European representatives expected to join subsequent rounds, indicating continued international diplomatic engagement. Ukrainian President Zelensky emphasized the centrality of the Donbas issue and called for increased US Patriot missile production. The anti-corruption operation 'Carthage' targeting Ukrainian prosecutors may affect domestic political stability, while the suspension of the Orlovka border checkpoint with Romania due to attacks on border infrastructure highlights the conflict's impact on civilian infrastructure.
sections.intelligence_notes: The redeployment of five Tu-95MS bombers from the Far East to Engels and Olenya airfields, with another expected, suggests preparation for a coordinated mass missile strike, likely targeting energy infrastructure. Russian forces continue to exploit their air advantage with widespread UAV attacks across multiple Ukrainian regions, while ground advances near Kostyantynivka indicate continued pressure in the Donbas. The Ukrainian strike on the Ryazan oil refinery demonstrates the capability to target critical Russian infrastructure, though the timing and scale of the attack remain unclear from available sources.
